title: Torrey View Hideaway | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched in an enviable location in Del Mar, this beautifully renovated end unit captures sweeping panoramic ocean views and a true sense of coastal serenity. With hardwood floors and an open-concept layout, the living area is filled with natural light and ocean breezes, setting the stage for easygoing luxury. The gourmet kitchen is a standout, offering sleek stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and refined finishes ideal for both quiet mornings and lively entertaining. Step outside to the expansive patio—perfect for sunset cocktails or al fresco dining with views that stretch to Torrey Pines State Park. The master suite is a haven unto itself, where each morning begins with unobstructed ocean vistas and the rhythm of the waves below. Resort-style amenities elevate every stay, including access to two sparkling pools, tennis courts, and a tranquil 4-acre park just moments away. From here, walk to the beach, explore nearby trails, or take a short drive to Del Mar’s top restaurants, Torrey Pines Golf Course, and the famous racetrack. Dog-friendly and thoughtfully appointed, this home delivers the quintessential Southern California escape—elegant, effortless, and unforgettable.
